content:
Noah: Putting the blog draft up for a quick pass — hero + bench highlight + CTA matrix. Want to lock copy and the tracking/route before I send to design.
Priya: Paste the hero + the benchmark line so legal can eyeball. Also which benchmark tag are we using (p99/p95/cost)?
Noah: Hero: 'Ship reliable LLM inference at predictable cost.'
Benchmark line: 'In our internal runs, Redwood Serve improved 95th percentile latency by up to 2.1x and reduced per-token spend ~12% on a mixed chat workload (avg turn=5, seq=384). Tests run on the open-lm-7B family, int8 quantized; details in bench notebook.'
Camille: Nice. Legal note: avoid "improved" without context? They want "in our tests" explicit and a link to methodology. Add a footnote link.
Noah: Updated: "In our tests, Redwood Serve improved p95 latency by up to 2.1x and lowered per-token costs by 12% (see bench notebook for methodology)." Link: https://internal.redwood/bench/2026-launch-notes
Ben: Ops: for CTAs — recommend two flows: (A) webinar sign-up -> nurture list, (B) demo claim -> demo ops queue + auto-schedule. Also a tertiary "Talk to sales" -> HubSpot SDR.
Priya: Can you draft the CSV mapping? Keep columns minimal.
Ben: Sure — copying here.
```
cta_text,hubspot_list,utm_campaign,follow_up_flow,variant
Sign up for the launch webinar,launch_webinar_2026,launch_q2_2026,webinar-nurture,A
Claim a demo slot,demo_claims_queue,launch_q2_2026,assign-demo-ops,B
Talk to sales,sdrc_sdr_queue,launch_q2_2026,sdr-hand-off,CT
```
Olivia: Add `source=blog` to the utm and append `?variant=A`/`?variant=B` as query param so Growth can track conversion. Also prefer `utm_source=blog` and `utm_medium=cta`.
Noah: Will update the CSV before handoff.
Camille: Webinar logistics: if we expect >150 signups, need 4 demo breakout hosts and timezone splits (EMEA/APAC/NA). Ben, can you confirm headcount?
Ben: I can put 4 hosts on the invite. PublishBot: calendar created for 2026-06-16 16:00 UTC, hosts: Ben, Olivia, Samir, Lena.
Priya: Legal quickpass request: attach bench notebook and include a short methodology snippet in the post body (model, quantization, dataset description). Also avoid absolute words like "guarantee".
Noah: Added method snippet: 'Methodology: mixed synthetic and anonymized app traces, avg 5-turn chats, tests ran on open-lm-7B int8. Bench scripts & raw data: https://internal.redwood/bench/2026-launch-notes.'
Camille: Copy edit: make hero sentence active and punchier: 'Reliable LLM inference. Predictable cost.' Two short lines instead of a long sentence.
Noah: Updated hero to two-line variant in the draft.
Priya: Growth approves the routing CSV. I'll export and upload to HubSpot once Ben finalizes the variant urls.
Ben: Final variant plan: default -> Variant A (webinar) for first 48h, then 50/50 split with Variant B for demo claims for the next week. Add `utm_content=variantA|variantB` for tracking.
Noah: Thanks — next steps list: 1) Ben finalize URLs with utm params, 2) Priya push CSV to HubSpot, 3) Camille run legal quickpass, attach bench link, 4) Olivia QA final copy in CMS.
Olivia: I'll do a publish QA and check canonical tags + social snippets. One ask: can we include a short tweetable line under the hero? If so I'll add two variants.
Noah: Go for it. Everyone, please react with :thumbsup: when ready and I'll flag for design handoff.
PublishBot: Design request created: ticket #DL-3421, due 2026-06-10."
